description: Serial installed-wheel validation of the historical 1.2.0 reference; not a comparison with installed game mechanics or prior performance.
method: Serial fresh processes outside the checkout, installed wheel built with uv build, Python3.14.9 and all installed dependency versions checked against the locked development environment. Four workers; single-commandery runs10 seconds maximum(3samples/backend); joint70commandery runs30 seconds maximum(2samples/backend). Wall includes module imports and shared solve_case, but not shell/uv/package installation. RSS is each process own ru_maxrss. First CP-SAT sample includes cold bytecode/cache effects. No tests or other native solves ran concurrently.
reproduce_default: uv run --locked twoptimizer three-kingdoms --commandery Yingchuan --algorithm cp-sat --algorithm highs --workers 4 --seconds 10
reproduce_joint: uv run --locked twoptimizer three-kingdoms --commandery all --joint --algorithm cp-sat --algorithm highs --workers 4 --seconds 30
reproduce_faction_matrix: uv run --locked twoptimizer three-kingdoms --faction all --commandery Yingchuan --algorithm cp-sat --algorithm highs --workers 4 --seconds 5
reproduce_independent_matrix: uv run --locked twoptimizer three-kingdoms --commandery all --algorithm cp-sat --algorithm highs --workers 4 --seconds 5
